Package com.csse3200.game.ui

Class PopupDisplay

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.rendering.RenderComponent
com.csse3200.game.ui.UIComponent
com.csse3200.game.ui.PopupDisplay
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Disposable, Renderable, Comparable<Renderable>
public class PopupDisplay extends UIComponent
Generic reusable popup: a dimmed backdrop behind a centred, closable window.

Starts empty and hidden. Callers add their own content via getContentTable() — a label, a form, widgets built by a ClickableFactory, anything — then call show() / hide() to toggle it.

      public void setOnShow(Runnable callback)
      Registers a callback run once at the end of every show(), after the window has been packed and positioned — so its bounds (getWindowX() etc.) are accurate. Used by callers with widgets outside the window's actor hierarchy that need to align themselves against it.
